articles.summary: According to Measurable AI’s analysis of millions of consumers’ transactional e-receipts: only 1% of Bukalapak’s users in 2024 overlapped with Shopee’s customer base. This wasn't a battle for the same shoppers. Bukalapak’s core users lived in a different world than Shopee's —more rural, cash-driven, with lower average order values (AOV).
articles.title: 1% Overlap between Shopee and Competitor – Indonesia E-Commerce Trends
